Signal 2 is a whole-tree token scan of read-shaped lines and distinctive quoted identifiers in product Python (the catalog pivot when a grep misses non-Python or dynamic defaults.get(field) consumers). Live product scans skip command-center/p2-wave/probes/ so sibling fixtures are not shipped config. This unit's own probe tree is excluded from live reads (use-vs-mention).

Per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json is written beside the probes (not tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write). cloud ok=true is not delivery. This worktree has no shipped plugin.json / marketplace / settings schema / workflow presets / .coverage-thresholds.json outside probe fixtures; live declared keys are the catalog defaults block plus any of those files that appear.
